description: This file defines a React functional component 'Signup' that provides a user registration form with email and password fields. It manages form state, handles form submission to invoke an authentication context's signUp method, and displays success or error messages accordingly.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles input change events, updating the form state with the new email or password entered by the user.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, calls the signUp method from context, manages loading state, and updates success or error messages based on the outcome.
